title: Contract Endpoint Within a Time Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and $C$ a contract for $M$ with exit set $E$. Suppose a starting configuration $d$ is in the entry state and satisfies the precondition for parameter $i$. For any natural number $B$ at least the prescribed running time, there is a time $t\leq B$ such that the run's state is outside $E$ at every earlier time and the configuration at time $t$ is the contract endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a contract for $M$ with exit set $E$
$i$ is a parameter and $d$ is a starting configuration
$d$ is in the contract entry state
The prescribed running time is at most $B$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $C$ be a contract for $M$. Suppose $d$
starts in the contract entry state and satisfies the precondition for parameter $i$. For
any natural-number bound $B$ with $C.\mathrm{time}(i,d)\le B$, there is a time $t\le B$
such that no earlier configuration has a state in the contract exit set, and the
configuration at time $t$ is the contract endpoint.
